hook: Before and after galleries, built for clinics. Meet Medical Before After Gallery Pro.
cinema: Cinema case windows. Every result, full screen, with a timeline of dated progress photos.
windows: Prefer a drawer, a comparison desk, or a case story? Choose yours.
layouts: Masonry, spotlight, editorial. And slider cards visitors drag right in the grid.
categories: Eight more category styles, and ninety-two icons.
embeds: Embed one case, with its timeline, on any page. Or a whole category carousel.
browse: Visitors browse by treatment, concern, doctor, or body map. Help me choose guides them. Compare puts two cases side by side.
design: Six design templates, with live preview. Watermarked copies, originals untouched. Sensitive photos, blurred until visitors choose.
end: Start free on WordPress.org, and upgrade to Pro, at medicalbeforeaftergallery.com.
